blurb: Guests can enjoy over 30 taps of year-round and rotating beers, a locally sourced seasonal menu, and a dog-friendly beer garden. The taproom spans two floors with indoor and outdoor seating. Guided brewery tours include a look at the brewing process and 3 beer tasters.
extraNote: 4% staff appreciation charge added to bill · 20% gratuity added to groups of 12 or more · All seating is first-come, first-served; no reservations except private events · Taproom at 4910 Nautilus Ct. N, Boulder, CO 80301
